title: KeyBoy, Targeted Attacks against Vietnam and India

attack_chain.summary: THAM luan- GD- NCKH2.doc executes svchost.exe
THAM luan- GD- NCKH2.doc loads svchost.exe
THAM luan- GD- NCKH2.doc loads KeyBoy

evidences.text: In this blog post we'll analyze two specific incidents apparently targeting victims in Vietnam and in India and we'll describe the capabilities of the custom backdoor being used that for convenience (and to our knowledge, for a lack of an existing name) we call KeyBoy , due to a string present in one of the samples.
Exploits and Payloads We encountered the first document exploit called " THAM luan- GD- NCKH2.doc " a few days ago, which appears to be leveraging some vulnerabilities patched with MS12-060 .
THAM luan- GD- NCKH2.doc Hash Value When executed the exploit initially creates and launches a dropper at location %Temp%\svchost.exe with the following hashes: svchost.exe
As mentioned, when the exploit is opened a dropper is created and launched, which then takes care of creating a Windows service called MdAdum , which is then visible in the registry as follows:
The dropper then launches the service with the DLL located at C:\WINDOWS\system32\CREDRIVER.dll and deletes itself.
silence.phdns01.com cpnet.phmail.us imlang.phmail.org The Indian backdoor tries to contact the following domains instead: cresy.zyns.com preter.epac.to backto.ddns.name
In the second set they are making use of a dynamic DNS service by ChangeIP.com.
